title: Low-degree branched projective structures form a universal affine bundle over a family of branching classes
author: Billon, Gustave
work: Moduli spaces of marked branched projective structures on surfaces
difficulty_reason: The affine-bundle conclusion depends on constructing relative branched projective atlases with prescribed branching class and identifying their differences through a relative Schwarzian equation. The new core forms an obstruction section via the Leray exact sequence, proves local holomorphic nonemptiness, and constructs a tautological universal family compatible with pullback. Serre duality supplies only the final low-degree vanishing; it does not supply these relative geometric constructions, which are retained in full and exceed ordinary PhD qualification exercises.
